notes: REF-BM-04: title/description/tags/note editable, but the edit form has no URL field (only server PATCH accepts url); URL is not editable via UI. REF-BM-14: tags are filterable (sidebar, chips, 'within label' dropdown that ANDs with text) but the search box does not parse '#tag' syntax; typing #tag is treated as literal text. REF-BM-15: AND (all-words), OR (any-words) and NOT (exclude-words) exist only as separate UI controls, not as in-term operators; no parenthesised groups and no quote-to-literalise-operator rule. REF-BM-16: exact-match exists as an 'exact phrase' checkbox applied to the whole query, not via quoted-phrase syntax and not combinable with other terms. REF-BM-20: bulk actions cover add-label, read/unread, archive, delete, but there is no bulk remove-tag action. REF-BM-23: notes use a contentEditable rich-text editor stored as sanitized HTML (bold/italic/list via execCommand); no markdown syntax is parsed. REF-BM-24: no page snapshot feature (only JSON backup/HTML export); PDF rule absent. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-32: only default sort persists (localStorage); no displayed-items or font-size settings and no settings UI.
